black_level.note: Known black of this body type; the free photon-transfer intercept reads 1903, black minus the read-noise term.

clip.note: Raw value the histogram piles up at; WHTLVLN reads 11765.

gain.note: EOS 100D class value. This camera: own shared fit 2.28-2.30 per channel over 3 sequence(s), clean per-pair median 2.43 (2.31-2.56). Sky photon transfer is a lower bound and its method floor is ~10%; replace with a flat-field photon transfer (panoptes/panoptes-pipeline#99).

read_noise.note: Photon-transfer intercept with black fixed; indicative to a few e-.
